name: runway-mcp
description: Runway (builder tools): me, generate_image, generate_video, get_job, list_items, get_item, create_it

platform_mcp_runway_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RUNWAY_API_KEY
platform_mcp_runway_api_key.description: Runway API key (dev.runwayml.com > API keys), sent as Authorization: Bearer; every request also carries X-Runway-Version: 2024-11-06.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/organization: tier limits, credit balance and usage.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: POST /v1/text_to_image {model (required: gen4_image, gen4_image_turbo, gpt_image_2 …), promptText, ratio (required, a pixel size such as 1920:1080 or 1024:1024), seed, referenceImages[{uri}] (required for gen4_image_turbo)} -> {id}; poll with get_job.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: POST /v1/text_to_video {model (required: gen4.5, veo3.1, veo3.1_fast …), promptText, ratio (required, e.g. 1280:720 or 720:1280), duration (2–10 s for gen4.5)} -> {id}; poll with get_job. image_url is not sent (image-to-video is POST /v1/image_to_video).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: GET /v1/tasks/{id}: status PENDING|THROTTLED|RUNNING|SUCCEEDED|FAILED|CANCELLED; output is the array of result URLs (expire in 24–48 h), failure/failureCode on error.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /v1/documents?limit&cursor: knowledge documents used by Runway Characters (items are documents). Cursor-paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /v1/documents/{id}: one knowledge document with its content.

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: POST /v1/documents {name, content (markdown or plain text)}: creates a knowledge document (title -> name).

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: PATCH /v1/documents/{id} {name, content}: renames and/or replaces the content.
